name: commit-writer
description: Writes conventional commit messages from git diff. Compact prompt optimized for small LLMs. Improved version of commit-message-generator.

inputs.name: Recent Commits
inputs.description: Recent commit messages for style reference

config.template:
Write a git commit message for these changes. Output ONLY the commit message.

Format: type(scope): subject

Types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore
Subject: imperative mood, no capital, no period, max 50 chars.

## Recent commits (follow this style)
{{recentCommits}}

## Git status
{{status}}

## Git diff
{{diff}}

## Example
feat(cli): add workspace template management command

Commit message:
